description.value: Victoria's first and largest board game cafe, offering access to over 1,500 games to play in-venue for a flat per-person fee with no time limit. Fully licensed since 2018 and family-friendly, the cafe serves an extensive menu of toasted sandwiches, flatbread pizzas, snacks, coffee drinks, and dozens of housemade milkshake flavours. A touring cyclist looking for a relaxed, social stop in downtown Victoria will find good food, cold drinks, and a genuinely unique atmosphere.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the OSM name, address (723 Yates St, Victoria, BC V8W 1L4), and phone number. The menu page explicitly lists a gluten-free bread option (+$1) on sandwiches marked with *, and multiple vegetarian items are present (Mediterranean sandwich, cheese flatbread, etc.). No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging is mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Most recent blog/news posts date from 2020–2022; website is otherwise active and functional but content may not be fully current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible licensed cafe in downtown Victoria with a full food and drink menu. A useful rest stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal or snack.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists gluten-free bread upgrade (+$1) on sandwiches marked with *; vegetarian options include The Mediterranean (hummus, feta, olives, cucumbers, tomato), Jack's Cheese, Grilled Cheese, Spicy Grilled Cheese, and multiple cheese-based flatbreads. Dairy-free milkshake options also noted
